pr_title: GameEngine: propose target-aware animation binding resolution
pr_body:
## Summary

- proposes ADR 0154 for shared target-aware Animation Set motion resolution
- moves Auto/Humanoid incompatibility feedback into pre-Play scene validation without blocking asset saves
- groups Humanoid with its canonical Native logical motion while preserving `motion_model_sources` semantics
- requires synthetic animation/rig fixtures for future implementation tests

## Scope

Design and documentation only. No runtime/editor implementation changes are included.
